purpose: Top 20 reviewer-facing recommendation table for second-pass confirmation.

items.title: OpenAI discontinues Sora video generation app, Disney pulls out of $1 billion investment deal
items.one_line_reason: Looks outside core game-industry scope despite strong structural wording.
items.review_note: Reasons already include non-game context and missing game context; treat as likely out-of-scope industry noise unless you explicitly want adjacent AI-business news in benchmark.

items.title: "I'm sorry we're here again," says Epic Games CEO as Fortnite maker lays off over 1000 employees
items.one_line_reason: Mass layoffs are a clear organizational signal, not a technical one.
items.review_note: Keep in benchmark, but correct the type to team. This is a strong example of studio/org structure change.

items.title: 'Things Are Looking Lukewarm Right Now' — Marathon Has Reportedly Sold Just 1.2 Million So Far, With Steam Making Up 70% of the Player Base
items.one_line_reason: This reads like commercial performance and player-base structure, not capital activity.
items.review_note: Likely market if retained. Because of report-style sourcing and high boundary score, you may also downgrade to boundary if you want only very clean market signals.

items.title: RPS Verdict: Anime racer Screamer slides sideways into success with its colourful, characterful driving
items.one_line_reason: This is a review article, which should stay outside structural-signal benchmark scope.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. Good negative sample for suppression of review-style content.

items.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 will dungeon-crawl through the blockworld yet again when it launches later this year
items.one_line_reason: Sequel announcement / coming-soon coverage is normal product news, not durable industry signal.
items.review_note: Keep as noise unless your benchmark deliberately includes title-only launch pipeline announcements, which current scope does not suggest.

items.title: Solve a crab housing crisis and fight a Dreadhog in part one of Runescape's big Havenhythe expansion, which is out now
items.one_line_reason: Expansion-content coverage is regular game update news, not a sector-level signal.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. Useful negative example for avoiding over-trigger on expansion/update wording.

items.title: Crimson Desert developers are "preparing to provide a smooth and stable gameplay experience" following Intel GPU launch woes
items.one_line_reason: Looks like product-quality / launch-fix messaging rather than broader structural change.
items.review_note: Keep as noise unless you want operational launch incidents as signal candidates, which would materially broaden benchmark scope.

items.title: Cornwall is overrun with mutant fish people and you are a fisherman with a nailgun in the boomer shooter BRINE
items.one_line_reason: Pure game feature/promo coverage should remain noise.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. Good suppression sample for descriptive trailer/feature copy.

items.title: EverQuest Legends is the 1999 MMO you know and love born again with more respect for your time
items.one_line_reason: Revival/relaunch style promo copy here still reads as ordinary product coverage.
items.review_note: Keep as noise unless there is hidden business-model or platform-structure detail in full text not present in the excerpt.

items.title: "It's essential to me that it's approached with care and love and caution" - How Life is Strange: Reunion actors Hannah Telle and Rhianna DeVries are preparing to say farewell to Max and Chloe
items.one_line_reason: Cast/interview coverage is not benchmark-worthy structural intelligence.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. Good negative sample for celebrity/interview entertainment content.

items.title: "It was just dripping in my lap" - Resident Evil Requiem's terrifying The Girl found her voice by drinking gallons of milk while recording
items.one_line_reason: Behind-the-scenes recording anecdote is clearly entertainment/editorial noise.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. Strong suppression case for human-interest production stories.

items.title: Marathon review
items.one_line_reason: Explicit review content should remain negative benchmark material.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. This is one of the cleanest negative examples in the set.

items.title: Crimson Desert's Pearl Abyss regains investor confidence as it continues to move beyond launch day woes
items.one_line_reason: Could sound market-relevant, but excerpt suggests commentary around sentiment rather than a discrete structural event.
items.review_note: Likely keep as noise; if full article contains concrete financing, strategic guidance, or measurable market shift, reassess.

items.title: Hades 2 trailer teases a new steamy scene that will be added with 'bonus content and quality-of-life improvements' in an update next month
items.one_line_reason: Trailer/update coverage is standard content news rather than industry intelligence.

items.one_line_reason: Cross-media casting/speculation coverage sits outside current game-industry signal scope.

items.one_line_reason: Feature-style impressions coverage should remain negative benchmark material.

items.one_line_reason: Actor career commentary is entertainment/news noise, not sector signal.

items.one_line_reason: Casting news for a movie adaptation is outside benchmark target scope.
items.review_note: Fast confirm as noise. Cross-media franchise casting should stay suppressed.

items.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3 is cranking up the challenge in a free new update, and its first story DLC might arrive sooner than expected
items.one_line_reason: Update/DLC cadence discussion is still ordinary product-news coverage.
items.review_note: Keep as noise unless full text unexpectedly contains a broader strategic or platform policy change.

items.title: Pearl Abyss is approaching the idea of a Crimson Desert Switch 2 port "with interest"
items.one_line_reason: Port-interest discussion without firm execution is normal roadmap chatter, not a durable market signal.
items.review_note: Likely stays noise; only reconsider if the full article confirms formal platform strategy or signed distribution action.
